title: foreignServer
description: A server-side mod created to change the server to your liking, with ground clear, chat and other features.
body:
# foreignServer

**_[[ This mod is only needed on the Server, It won't help much on a singleplayer world! ]]_**

A mod that aims to improve your server quality by offering features from general plugins from bukkit/spigot servers like:

- **Ground Clear**, every 15 minutes the ground gets cleared from all items, reducing lag.
- **Custom Chat**, let the chat be prettier! Change it to whatever you prefer! (LuckPerms Hook if needed!)
- **Custom Death Messages**, change the death messages to your liking!
- **Highly Configurable**, change every aspect to achieve your ideal server!

This is one of my first mods, so I'm still looking for new features and ideas for the mod!
Any advice is accepted!
